IC1: - Patients have been diagnosed with Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
IC2: - Childhood patients [AND] who were undergoing chemotherapy [OR] or continuous follow-up after completion of chemotherapy
IC3: - Patients received the phase of maintenance therapy that included oral 6-MP (>4 weeks) and completion of ≥ 6 months according to the CCLG (Chinese Children's Leukemia Group) protocol-ALL 2015
